routes.name: GCC citizen entry
routes.summary: Citizens of GCC countries do not need a visa to enter the UAE. Passport must be valid at least 6 months.

other: Official page only covers entry. It does not say how long you can stay or whether you can work.

sources.label: u.ae Do you need a visa to enter the UAE

routes.name: Visa on arrival / visa-free entry (country lists)
routes.summary: Citizens of some countries get a visa on arrival. Everyone else needs a visa before travel. The official pages I could open do not list the countries or day limits.

other: Country lists and stay lengths were not readable on an official page. Check the ICP or GDRFA list before travel.
Passport valid at least 6 months from entry.

sources.label: u.ae Do you need a visa to enter the UAE

routes.name: 5-year multiple-entry tourist visa
routes.summary: Multiple-entry tourist visa open to all nationalities. Up to 90 days per visit, and each stay can be extended by another 90 days.

savings.note: bank balance over the last six months, or equivalent

other: UAE-valid health insurance covering 180 days
Ticket showing onward or return travel

stay.note: Stay can be extended by another 90 days.

steps: Apply online through ICP or GDRFA Dubai, or through a UAE-based airline, licensed travel agent or hotel. UAE embassies do not issue tourist visas.

routes.name: eVisa for GCC residents
routes.summary: Residents of other GCC countries in approved professions can get a 30-day entry permit. Stay is 30 days from entry, extendable once for 30 days.

other: GCC residency valid at least 1 year from arrival
Passport valid at least 6 months from arrival
Profession must be on the approved list

routes.name: Standard work residence visa
routes.summary: Employer-sponsored residence visa for working in the UAE. Valid for two years and renewable. The employer applies.

other: Steps, documents and fees were not on the page I could read. See ICP or GDRFA service pages.

sources.label: u.ae Residence visa for working in the UAE

routes.name: Green Residence: skilled employee
routes.summary: Five-year renewable self-sponsored residence for skilled employees. No employer sponsor needed to hold it.

other: Valid UAE employment contract
MoHRE occupational skill level 1 to 3

sources.label: u.ae Residence visa for working in the UAE

routes.name: Green Residence: freelancer / self-employed
routes.summary: Five-year renewable self-sponsored residence for freelancers and self-employed people.

eligibility.education: bachelor's degree, specialized diploma or equivalent
other: Freelance or self-employment permit from MoHRE
Freelance income of at least AED 360,000 in each of the previous two years (or equivalent)
Proof of stable annual income or solvency for the length of the residence

routes.name: Green Residence: investor / partner
routes.summary: Five-year renewable residence for investors and business partners in a UAE business.

other: Proof of investment or contribution to a UAE business
Licenses and approvals from the relevant authorities
No investment amount is stated on the page I read.

routes.name: Virtual Work Residence (remote work visa)
routes.summary: One-year visa for people who work remotely for a company outside the UAE. Self-sponsored.

other: Proof of employment with a company outside the UAE
Health insurance
Medical fitness test

sources.label: u.ae Residence visa for working outside the UAE

steps: Apply through the ICP smart services portal or GDRFA Dubai.

routes.name: Retiree residence (Dubai GDRFA)
routes.summary: Five-year renewable residence for retirees, no sponsor needed. This is the Dubai GDRFA service page.

other: At least 15 years of service before retirement, inside or outside the UAE
Meet one of: own UAE property worth AED 1,000,000 or more; a deposit of at least AED 1,000,000; or fixed annual income of at least AED 240,000 (six months of bank statements)
A deposit held abroad must be moved to a UAE financial institution within 60 days of issuance unless invested in the UAE

stay.note: 60-day grace period after expiry or cancellation.

routes.processing: Expected completion 48 hours, per the official page.

routes.name: Golden Visa: investor
routes.summary: Ten-year renewable residence for public investment of at least AED 2 million.

routes.name: Golden Visa: real estate investor
routes.summary: Five-year renewable residence for property owners, or for contributing to an establishment that pays at least AED 250,000 a year in taxes.

other: The page does not state a minimum property value. Check the ICP eligibility tool.
Alternative: contribution to an establishment paying at least AED 250,000 annually in taxes

routes.name: Golden Visa: entrepreneur
routes.summary: Five-year renewable residence for entrepreneurs with an innovative or technical project.

other: Proof of an innovative or technical project and documents showing its value
Letter from a business incubator or relevant authority in the emirate

routes.name: Golden Visa: exceptional talent / rare specializations
routes.summary: Ten-year renewable residence for doctors, scientists, inventors, culture and arts creatives, executives, athletes, PhD holders and specialists in priority fields.

other: Each subcategory has its own requirements (recommendation letters, experience, accredited degrees). The page does not give them.
ICP page mentions a GPA of 3.8 or more for outstanding students only.

routes.name: Golden Visa: outstanding students
routes.summary: Five years for outstanding high school students and ten years for top university students. Needs certificates of excellence and a recommendation letter from the school or university.

other: Certificates of excellence
Recommendation letter from the school or university
ICP page mentions a GPA of 3.8 or more

stay.note: 5 years for high school students, 10 years for top university students.

routes.name: Golden Visa: humanitarian pioneers and frontline heroes
routes.summary: Ten-year renewable residence for humanitarian pioneers and frontline heroes.

other: Certificates of appreciation, documented humanitarian contribution, or at least 5 years of service

routes.name: Family residence (sponsored by a resident)
routes.summary: A UAE resident can sponsor a spouse, unmarried daughters, sons under 25 and children with special needs. Green visa holders can also sponsor first-degree relatives.

income.note: sponsor minimum, or AED 3,000 plus accommodation provided

other: Family members 18 or older need a medical fitness test
Visa is tied to the sponsor's visa. 6-month grace period after expiry or cancellation.

sources.label: u.ae Residence visa for families of employees

routes.name: Humanitarian residence (relatives with a sponsor)
routes.summary: One-year renewable residence for people with a sponsor or host who meets their humanitarian needs, such as parents or certain divorced or widowed women. A committee reviews each case. This is not an asylum process.

other: Parent sponsorship needs a minimum salary of AED 10,000, or partnership documents for partners and investors
A financial guarantee of AED 5,000 per request may be required, capped at AED 15,000 total

stay.note: 60-day grace period after expiry or cancellation.

routes.name: Student residence visa
routes.summary: Study in the UAE on a visa sponsored by a resident parent or by your accredited university or college.

other: Certificate from the university stating the study period
Sons can be sponsored by a parent up to age 25 (older if proving higher education). Daughters until marriage.
General residence visa conditions also apply. Validity is tied to the study period.

sources.label: u.ae Residence visa for studying in the UAE

routes.name: Emirati citizenship (nomination only)
routes.summary: No normal application route. Citizenship is granted only by nomination for selected foreigners (and their spouses and children), through the Rulers' or Crown Princes' Courts, Executive Council offices or the Cabinet.

other: Investors must own UAE property
Doctors and specialists: high-demand expertise, at least 10 years of experience, membership in a reputable organization
Scientists: active researchers, 10+ years, recommendation from a recognized UAE scientific institution
Inventors: approved patents plus a Ministry recommendation
Creatives: field pioneers with at least one international award and a government recommendation
The page does not cover birth, descent or marriage routes.

citizenship.note: Naturalized citizens may keep their original nationality but must notify the UAE government of any change. Citizenship can be withdrawn for breaching conditions.
